rugs.ai_description: This rug is an intricately designed Persian Kashan with a central medallion and floral motifs. It features rich colors such as red, navy, and ivory, typical of antique craftsmanship.
The rug features an intricate floral design typical of Persian Isfahan pieces, primarily in ivory, beige, and gold tones. Its delicate motifs and classic borders convey a traditional mood.

This rug features an intricate pictorial design with a vibrant landscape scene and architectural elements, showcasing detailed imagery of birds and plants. The rug emphasizes traditional Persian artistry with a contemporary aesthetic.
The rug showcases a central medallion with intricate floral motifs on a red background and an elaborate border. It exhibits an antique Persian style with traditional craftsmanship.

This is an antique Persian Kashan rug featuring a central medallion design with intricate floral motifs and a detailed border. Predominantly in red and navy against an ivory background, it exemplifies traditional craftsmanship.
This rug features a rich floral design in warm tones of red, green, and gold, typical of the Sultanabad style. The intricate patterns and color palette suggest an antique Persian origin.
This is an antique Persian Sultanabad rug featuring an intricate all-over pattern with floral motifs on a dark field. The border has detailed designs enhancing its traditional appeal.
This rug is a finely detailed Persian Tabriz, showcasing a rich red field with intricate floral motifs and a contrasting floral border. It reflects traditional craftsmanship from the antique era.
This rug features a classic Persian Tabriz design with an intricate medallion center. Rich tones of red, navy, and gold dominate its traditional aesthetic.
This rug features a rich pictorial design with intricate motifs set against a vibrant red field, complemented by a detailed floral border.
This is an antique Persian rug featuring a vivid pictorial scene with animals and figures against a red background. Its intricate border enhances its traditional aesthetic.
This is a Persian Isfahan rug featuring a central medallion with intricate floral motifs and a surrounding floral border. The design is detailed and showcases traditional craftsmanship.

This rug features a striking central medallion with geometric and floral motifs typical of Persian Heriz rugs. The dominant color palette includes red, teal, and gold, contributing to its bold, traditional appearance.
The rug exhibits a worn and distressed surface, indicative of age and use. The colors include gold, red, and green with a traditional design style.
This is a Persian Qom rug featuring a detailed pictorial design with animal and floral motifs. It exhibits a traditional and intricate decorative style, typical of high-quality Persian craftsmanship.
This rug features a detailed pictorial design with portraits and intricate calligraphy. The rich color palette includes red, ivory, and brown, creating a traditional and striking appearance.
This is an antique Persian Sultanabad rug showcasing an intricate floral motif with a central medallion design. The rich red, navy, and gold colors highlight its classic appeal.
This is a vintage Persian Kashan rug featuring a central medallion with intricate floral motifs. Dominantly navy with accents of red, ivory, and pink.

This is a vintage Caucasian Shirvan rug featuring a geometric design with a dark color palette of navy, red, and gold tones. The intricate pattern and bold borders highlight its traditional craftsmanship.

This rug features a complex floral motif with a rich red background and intricate borders, typical of Persian artistry. It exudes a vintage charm with its elaborate detailing and harmonious color palette.

This is an antique Persian Bakhtiari rug featuring a rich botanical design with a navy field and vibrant floral motifs. The intricate borders complement the central pattern, showcasing traditional craftsmanship.
This is an antique Persian Sultanabad rug featuring a floral motif in soft ivory, blue, and rust tones. Its intricate pattern and aged appearance suggest a high level of craftsmanship.

This is an antique Persian Heriz rug featuring a vibrant all-over floral pattern with a rich combination of blue, red, and ivory colors. The classic design and quality craftsmanship reflect the traditional themes of the Heriz style.

This vintage Persian Bakhtiari rug features a lattice pattern with various floral and pictorial motifs. The rich color palette includes rust, ivory, and gold tones, creating a visually intricate piece.
This is an antique Persian Tabriz rug featuring a detailed floral motif with rich red and navy hues. The intricate design and classic border enhance its traditional appeal.
This is an antique Caucasian Karabagh rug featuring a complex geometric design with a central medallion. The rug displays rich greens, blues, and oranges.
This rug features a rich red field with an intricate geometric design, typical of Persian Heriz styles. Its bold medallion and complex border add to its traditional charm.

This is an antique Persian Tabriz rug featuring a complex floral motif with a prominent medallion and a rich color palette including navy, red, and ivory. Its intricate design and detailed border showcase traditional artistry.

This rug is a Persian Heriz with a striking geometric medallion design in rich red and navy tones. Its traditional style and durable construction make it an excellent choice for a classic decor setting.
This is an antique Persian Bakhtiari rug featuring a geometric design with floral motifs. The rich red, navy, and cream colors create a traditional and vibrant appearance.
This is an antique Turkish Oushak rug featuring large-scale floral motifs in soft, muted shades of pink, green, and gold. The worn texture suggests it has aged gracefully, adding a historical charm.
An antique Persian Sultanabad rug featuring a floral motif with a rich rust field and complementary borders. The lush botanical design embodies traditional craftsmanship.
This is an antique Persian Heriz rug featuring a bold medallion center design. The rug displays a rich palette of navy, red, and ivory, embodying a traditional mood.

This is an intricately designed antique Persian Tabriz rug featuring a central medallion and floral motifs. The rich red and green tones contribute to its traditional atmosphere.

This is an antique Turkish Oushak rug, characterized by its soft motifs and warm color palette. The rug features an all-over pattern with floral and geometric elements, typical of traditional Oushak designs.
This is an antique Persian Heriz rug featuring a geometric design with a prominent medallion and floral motifs. The primary colors are rich rust, navy, and teal accentuated by ivory and gold tones.

This is a vintage Caucasian Kilim rug, featuring bold geometric patterns with a mix of red, blue, and ivory colors. The flat-weave construction highlights its traditional tribal design, suitable for eclectic or transitional decor.

This is a vintage Turkish Oushak rug featuring a geometric design with muted red and green tones. The central medallion and border patterns are characteristic of traditional Oushak styles.
This is an antique Persian Serapi rug featuring a bold medallion and geometric design. The rich color palette includes red and navy, accented by ivory and brown tones.
This vibrant vintage Persian rug features a bold tribal design with pictorial elements, depicting a rider on horseback. The vivid red background is accented by striking blue and ivory motifs.

This is an antique Caucasian Kazak rug featuring vibrant geometric patterns and a rich color palette of red, teal, and ivory. Its distinct tribal design and traditional craftsmanship make it a timeless collectible piece.

This is a traditional Caucasian Kazak rug featuring bold geometric patterns with a strong central medallion and vibrant colors. It displays a classic tribal design with multiple borders and intricate motifs.
